descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S24b 「日期错或在另一个时区的真手机，显示的状态和电脑一样」 Real phone on the wrong date or another time zone shows the same state as the computer

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Time-based state uses the server clock: a device with a wrong clock, no clock set or another time zone shows the same state as the other device (badge after the day roll, hospital day / visit number, …（UAT 3.8；TFA-92584 AC 8）

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Computer on the correct clock (JST); a real phone with its device clock set one day ahead, then to UTC-10. {hospitalPatient} set to New Admission yesterday (server time)

When Open the list and the chart on both; generate a note on the phone

Then Both show the same badge (rolled to Follow-up once), the same hospital day / visit number, and the same 'today' date on the note and the timeline

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：A person compares the two screens field by field; any difference is a Fail. Known: TFA-92584 (day roll and transcriptDate use the device clock). The web half is automated in S24a

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S24b 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号；字母后缀 = 一个用例拆成了几条），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
